Alexander Seidel
Age
: 41
Cap number
: 26
Location
: Leipzig, Germany
Bike
: Trek Checkout.
The drivetrain is a SRAM Force/Eagle AXS mullet with a 10-52t cassette and a 38t chainring. I ride a custom-made carbon wheelset from ROTOR Bikes Leipzig. The rear wheel has an extremely lightweight Nonplus Primaro hub. The front wheel uses a SON 29s hub to power the SON Ladelux.
The wheelset is completed with a set of Vittoria Mezcal Race 55mm tires. I also use a super-light DARIMO seatpost. Front suspension 60mm of travel. Rear suspension 55mm of travel.
Key items of kit
: The bags are a mix of Tailfin, Reisefix (feather light), and Cyclite.
The Reisefix bag is custom-made for this frame. It's made of incredibly lightweight and durable Dyneema, and it's waterproof. All electronic devices are charged by the SON Ladulux. For navigation, I use the Coros Dura, which is unbeatable in terms of battery capacity.
I also wear an EVOC 6L hydration vest.
Musical support: SML b2b Bogdan Krawallovic ;)

riders.key_items: I'm using a Garmin Edge 1040 Solar for navigation and an Exposure Maxx-D Mk17 front light. My bikepacking bags are all Tailfin, including their CargoPack, Long Top Tube Bag and Frame Bag. Since I'm not carrying a sleeping system for this race (which I'd normally store in the CargoPack), I've decided to omit my usual fork packs and store what I'd typically have there out back.
